description: Belgium Insolvency Check (Moniteur belge / Belgisch Staatsblad). Check Belgian companies for insolvency by enterprise number (KBO/BCE, e.g. 0656.956.749 or BE0656956749, check digits verified; up to 500) or company name (up to 50) in the Belgian Official Gazette (Moniteur belge / Belgisch Staatsblad). One row per insolvency notice published in the date window - bankruptcy_opened, restructuring_opened (judicial reorganisation), plan_confirmed, proceeding_closed, proceeding_revoked or other court decisions - with court, case reference, judgment and publication dates, claims deadline and the address and activity printed in the notice. Window: at most 30 days per run, default the last 7 days, notices from 2025-01-01; the window sets the run time (about 1-3 minutes per publication day), so send all companies in one call. No row for an entry means no insolvency notice in that window - not a full history: a bankruptcy opened before the window is not shown. An entry whose window could not be fully read is NOT checked (unknown, not clear) and not charged; invalid numbers, numbers not in the enterprise register and natural persons (sole traders) are skipped and not charged. Companies and other legal persons only; court appointees by role only. No API key. Advanced fields beyond this schema are also accepted (regdata_describe lists them).

companyNames.description: Company names to look for in the notices, e.g. "Eurocon Infra". Every word must appear in the company name (or its trade name) in any order; the legal form (SRL, BV, NV, SA...) is ignored. Up to 50 per run.
companyNames.title: Company names

dateFrom.description: Start of the publication-date window (YYYY-MM-DD). Clear both dates to check the last 7 days. The window is at most 30 days; notices are available from 2025-01-01. Each publication day in the window is billed once per run, so check all your companies in one run.
dateFrom.title: Published from

dateTo.description: End of the publication-date window (YYYY-MM-DD). Leave empty for today.
dateTo.title: Published to

enterpriseNumbers.description: Belgian enterprise numbers to check: 0417.497.106, 0417497106 or BE0417497106. The check digits are verified. The most precise check - use it whenever you have the number. Up to 500 per run.
enterpriseNumbers.title: Enterprise numbers (KBO/BCE)

exactNameMatch.description: Off (default): every company whose name contains all the words. On: only companies whose name equals the query, ignoring case, accents, punctuation and legal form. No effect on enterprise numbers.
exactNameMatch.title: Exact name match

maxItems.description: Optional cap on billed dataset items returned.

maxNoticesPerName.description: The most notices returned for one company name, newest first (default 20). Enterprise numbers always return every notice in the window.
maxNoticesPerName.title: Max notices per company name

name: regdata_belgium_insolvency
